title: Phase 2: static check (apricity check) with suggestions and transpose stable
description: crates/apricity-theory/src/clash.rs and crates/apricity-score/src/check.rs: the same kernel on span-local PCPs and manifest notes, pitched tracks included. Suggestions with predicted deltas (shifts, stable shift, chord substitutions via assist::palette, bass voicings), flip-flop detection from runners_up margins, an opt-in transpose stable, and a shared kernel fixture tested in both Rust and Python.
